description: Three field contacts at a safe house, and a leak to the cult. Covers knockouts and locking contacts away as the only verdicts, hidden stakes, the nudge switched off and an RFID clone used as evidence. Not a mission.
_note: display_name and description wording invented: plan silent beyond 'Not a mission.'. Scoring is the default (plan §9.3 'Scoring: the default'); written out as "tasks" so DL9(g) reads it without falling back.
